release_notes:
- New: **Submissions** (Write > Submissions) tracks the papers you send to journals: each submission, its timeline, files, how long you have been waiting, and deadlines on Home.
- Submissions: write your response to reviewers point by point and export it to Word; paste the editor's decision letter and the AI fills in the decision, dates and reviewer comments for you.
- Nexus AI: the Home counter now shows the operations you have really used (it could stay at 0).
- Nexus AI: the plan window lists every AI action and what it costs, and course licences no longer show a monthly reset they do not have.
- Paid plans: your AI operations now come as one yearly allowance, so a full review fits even if you do most of it in one month. AI Boost Packs are now applied as soon as you buy them.
- AI error messages now tell you when the problem is on our side and not yours.
- macOS: updating while Nexus is open now restarts it properly instead of showing "An error has occurred!".
- Full-text finder: a paper it cannot find now fails in seconds instead of freezing the table.
- Projects: the project cards load much faster.
- Meta-analysis: forest plots show the right first author for PubMed-style names (no more "S et al.").
